text:
Maya: Heads up — spotted ~2.3% invoice drift for acme-inc this morning.
Rahul: Dashboard shows spike in charges attributed to `default-route`. Could be missing route tags.
Maya: I pulled raw events and saw ~6k events between 16:05-16:20 with `route_id: null`.
Jon: That aligns with my canary for edge-proxy v2.3.4 (PR #1209) where I enabled `strip_empty_headers`.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T16:05 -> edge-proxy v2.3.4 (canary 10/100) complete.
Rahul: Hypothesis: header canonicalization converted absent `x-route-id` into explicit JSON null; metering consumer treats null as "present but empty" -> fallback to default route.
Maya: Example sanitized event:
{"event_id":"evt_abc","tenant_id":"acme-inc","session_id":"sess_123","tokens":314,"headers":{"user-agent":"sdk/1.2.0"},"route_id":null}
Jon: I can revert quickly. Rolling back canary now.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated 16:25 -> edge-proxy v2.3.3.
Ellie: Console action: add alert when percent of events with null/empty route_id > 0.5% (15m window) and a per-route attribution trend card. I'll file a ticket.
Rahul: Short-term repair: rehydrate route_id via session->route_map and replay to `billing-repair`. Quick SQL to find candidates: SELECT event_id FROM billing.events WHERE route_id IS NULL AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions.route_map WHERE ts > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 3 HOUR));
Jon: Also adding shim in metering consumer to treat explicit null same as missing and attempt join before defaulting.
Ops-Bot: ops-bot: incident 2026-03-21-176950 created.
Maya: I'm running the repair job now; will post counts in ~20-30m.
Jon: Postmortem action items: 1) revert `strip_empty_headers` default, 2) add integration test to detect invoice deltas >0.1% from header changes, 3) add an end-to-end telemetry contract for header preservation.
Maya: Thanks — keep updates here and in the incident channel. :thumbsup:
